title: Ernest Shackleton's birth chart
metaDescription: Ernest Shackleton's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.7° Aquarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Aquarius — the Sun, the Moon, Venus and Saturn. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 26.7° of Aquarius is the Sun's exact seat — third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Venus in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 6.2° Pisces; Venus stands at 24.7° Aquarius; Mars stands at 4.7° Aries. The tradition reads thought steeped in tone and memory from Mercury, attraction that begins as conversation from Venus, effort spent in bursts and openings from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Saturn and Uranus — a opposition holding at 0.1°. Oppositions are read as full-moon geometry — maximum visibility between two needs that share one spine. Behind it, the Sun sextile Neptune at 0.5°, and Venus sextile Neptune at 1.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks four placements here. The Sun in Aquarius at 26.7° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mercury in Pisces at 6.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Aries at 4.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Aquarius at 7.6° is in domicile. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 5, fire 3, water 1, earth 1; modalities fixed 6, cardinal 3, mutable 1. Jupiter and Uranus were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aquarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.7° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 8.9°.
